sentences.text: Elena y su abuelo Tomás viajaron al campo en una vieja caravana.
sentences.en: Elena and her grandfather Tomás traveled to the countryside in an old camper van.
sentences.ko: 엘레나와 할아버지 토마스는 낡은 캠핑카를 타고 시골로 갔어요.

sentences.text: En el puerto vieron una caravana de camiones esperando el barco.
sentences.en: At the port they saw a convoy of trucks waiting for the ship.
sentences.ko: 항구에서 배를 기다리는 트럭 행렬을 봤어요.

sentences.text: El chófer del autobús les recomendó parar a ver el paisaje del valle.
sentences.en: The bus driver recommended they stop to see the valley's landscape.
sentences.ko: 버스 기사가 계곡 풍경을 보러 잠깐 서 보라고 권했어요.

sentences.text: El chófer del hotel los llevó hasta el muelle.
sentences.en: The hotel driver took them to the dock.
sentences.ko: 호텔 기사가 그들을 부두까지 데려다줬어요.

sentences.text: El chófer del autobús les recomendó parar a ver el paisaje del valle.
sentences.en: The bus driver recommended they stop to see the valley's landscape.
sentences.ko: 버스 기사가 계곡 풍경을 보러 잠깐 서 보라고 권했어요.

sentences.text: Desde el barco, el paisaje de la costa era precioso.
sentences.en: From the boat, the coastal landscape was beautiful.
sentences.ko: 배에서 보는 해안 풍경이 정말 아름다웠어요.

sentences.text: En la granja, el gallo cantó muy temprano.
sentences.en: On the farm, the rooster crowed very early.
sentences.ko: 농장에서 수탉이 아주 일찍 울었어요.

sentences.text: En el jardín del hotel vivían una gallina y un gallo.
sentences.en: A hen and a rooster lived in the hotel garden.
sentences.ko: 호텔 정원에는 암탉과 수탉이 살았어요.

sentences.text: Tomás guardaba el heno en un granero de madera.
sentences.en: Tomás kept the hay in a wooden barn.
sentences.ko: 토마스는 나무 헛간에 건초를 보관했어요.

sentences.text: El restaurante del puerto era un antiguo granero.
sentences.en: The port restaurant used to be a barn.
sentences.ko: 항구 식당은 원래 헛간이었어요.

sentences.text: Los caballos dormían en un establo limpio y tranquilo.
sentences.en: The horses slept in a clean, quiet stable.
sentences.ko: 말들은 깨끗하고 조용한 마구간에서 잤어요.

sentences.text: Al lado había un establo con caballos para los turistas.
sentences.en: Next to it there was a stable with horses for tourists.
sentences.ko: 옆에는 관광객용 말이 있는 마구간이 있었어요.

sentences.text: Una vaca acababa de tener una cría preciosa.
sentences.en: A cow had just had a beautiful calf.
sentences.ko: 소 한 마리가 막 예쁜 새끼를 낳았어요.

sentences.text: La cría del delfín nadaba pegada a su madre.
sentences.en: The baby dolphin swam close to its mother.
sentences.ko: 새끼 돌고래가 엄마 곁에 꼭 붙어 헤엄쳤어요.

sentences.text: Una manada de ovejas cruzó el camino delante de ellos.
sentences.en: A flock of sheep crossed the road in front of them.
sentences.ko: 양 떼가 그들 앞으로 길을 건넜어요.

sentences.text: Vieron una manada de delfines saltando cerca del barco.
sentences.en: They saw a pod of dolphins jumping near the boat.
sentences.ko: 배 근처에서 뛰어오르는 돌고래 떼를 봤어요.

sentences.text: Elena vio una fila de hormigas cargando migas de pan.
sentences.en: Elena saw a line of ants carrying breadcrumbs.
sentences.ko: 엘레나는 빵 부스러기를 나르는 개미 행렬을 봤어요.

sentences.text: Había hormigas en la mesa del desayuno.
sentences.en: There were ants on the breakfast table.
sentences.ko: 아침 식탁에 개미가 있었어요.

sentences.text: El águila llevaba un pez entre las garras.
sentences.en: The eagle was carrying a fish in its claws.
sentences.ko: 독수리가 발톱에 물고기를 쥐고 있었어요.

sentences.text: Una gaviota atrapó un pez con las garras.
sentences.en: A seagull caught a fish with its claws.
sentences.ko: 갈매기가 발톱으로 물고기를 낚아챘어요.

sentences.text: El agua del río fluía rápido entre las piedras.
sentences.en: The river water flowed fast between the stones.
sentences.ko: 강물이 돌 사이로 빠르게 흘렀어요.

sentences.text: Las ideas empezaron a fluir cuando Marco se relajó.
sentences.en: The ideas began to flow when Marco relaxed.
sentences.ko: 마르코가 긴장을 풀자 생각이 술술 나오기 시작했어요.

sentences.text: Se sentaron sobre el tronco de un árbol caído.
sentences.en: They sat on the trunk of a fallen tree.
sentences.ko: 그들은 쓰러진 나무 둥치 위에 앉았어요.

sentences.text: Un tronco flotaba en el agua cerca del puerto.
sentences.en: A log was floating in the water near the port.
sentences.ko: 항구 근처 물에 통나무가 떠 있었어요.

sentences.text: Tomás contó que una plaga de insectos destruyó la cosecha hace años.
sentences.en: Tomás said a plague of insects destroyed the harvest years ago.
sentences.ko: 토마스는 몇 년 전 벌레 떼가 농사를 망쳤다고 했어요.

sentences.text: Una plaga de mosquitos les arruinó la cena.
sentences.en: A swarm of mosquitoes ruined their dinner.
sentences.ko: 모기떼 때문에 저녁을 망쳤어요.

sentences.text: Por la mañana desayunaron cereal con leche fresca.
sentences.en: In the morning they had cereal with fresh milk.
sentences.ko: 아침에 그들은 신선한 우유에 시리얼을 먹었어요.

sentences.text: Marco tomó un tazón de cereal antes de navegar.
sentences.en: Marco had a bowl of cereal before sailing.
sentences.ko: 마르코는 배를 타기 전에 시리얼 한 그릇을 먹었어요.

sentences.text: Tomás come mucha fibra para cuidar su estómago.
sentences.en: Tomás eats a lot of fiber to take care of his stomach.
sentences.ko: 토마스는 위를 챙기려고 섬유질을 많이 먹어요.

sentences.text: El pan integral tiene más fibra que el blanco.
sentences.en: Whole-grain bread has more fiber than white bread.
sentences.ko: 통밀빵은 흰 빵보다 섬유질이 많아요.

sentences.text: En el calendario de la cocina estaban marcadas las fiestas del pueblo.
sentences.en: The village festivals were marked on the kitchen calendar.
sentences.ko: 부엌 달력에 마을 축제가 표시돼 있었어요.

sentences.text: Marco apuntó la fecha del regreso en su calendario.
sentences.en: Marco wrote down the return date in his calendar.
sentences.ko: 마르코는 돌아오는 날짜를 달력에 적었어요.

sentences.text: La feria anual del pueblo se celebra en verano.
sentences.en: The village's annual fair is held in summer.
sentences.ko: 마을의 연례 장터는 여름에 열려요.

sentences.text: El festival anual de música llena la ciudad de gente.
sentences.en: The annual music festival fills the city with people.
sentences.ko: 매년 열리는 음악 축제로 도시가 사람들로 가득 차요.

sentences.text: La iglesia del pueblo es de una gran antigüedad.
sentences.en: The village church is very old.
sentences.ko: 마을 교회는 아주 오래됐어요.

sentences.text: El museo tenía objetos de gran antigüedad.
sentences.en: The museum had very ancient objects.
sentences.ko: 박물관에는 아주 오래된 물건들이 있었어요.

sentences.text: Tomás dice que envejecer en el campo es más tranquilo.
sentences.en: Tomás says growing old in the countryside is more peaceful.
sentences.ko: 토마스는 시골에서 나이 드는 게 더 평온하다고 해요.

sentences.text: Su abuela dice que envejecer no da miedo si tienes amigos.
sentences.en: His grandmother says growing old isn't scary if you have friends.
sentences.ko: 그의 할머니는 친구가 있으면 나이 드는 게 무섭지 않다고 해요.

sentences.text: Del fuego salió una chispa y Elena dio un salto.
sentences.en: A spark flew out of the fire and Elena jumped.
sentences.ko: 불에서 불꽃이 튀어서 엘레나가 깜짝 놀랐어요.

sentences.text: Una chispa del motor asustó al capitán.
sentences.en: A spark from the engine startled the captain.
sentences.ko: 엔진에서 튄 불꽃에 선장이 놀랐어요.

sentences.text: Del café caliente salía vapor.
sentences.en: Steam was rising from the hot coffee.
sentences.ko: 뜨거운 커피에서 김이 났어요.

sentences.text: El motor del barco soltaba vapor blanco.
sentences.en: The boat's engine let out white steam.
sentences.ko: 배 엔진에서 하얀 김이 나왔어요.

sentences.text: Por la noche, el brillo de las estrellas era increíble.
sentences.en: At night, the shine of the stars was incredible.
sentences.ko: 밤에는 별빛이 정말 대단했어요.

sentences.text: El sol se reflejaba con un brillo dorado en el agua.
sentences.en: The sun reflected on the water with a golden shine.
sentences.ko: 햇빛이 물 위에 금빛으로 반짝였어요.

sentences.text: Elena sueña con ser viajera y recorrer el oriente del país.
sentences.en: Elena dreams of being a traveler and touring the east of the country.
sentences.ko: 엘레나는 여행자가 되어 나라의 동쪽을 돌아보는 게 꿈이에요.

sentences.text: Un viajero alemán les contó historias de sus viajes.
sentences.en: A German traveler told them stories about his trips.
sentences.ko: 독일인 여행자가 자기 여행 이야기를 들려줬어요.

sentences.text: Elena sueña con ser viajera y recorrer el oriente del país.
sentences.en: Elena dreams of being a traveler and touring the east of the country.
sentences.ko: 엘레나는 여행자가 되어 나라의 동쪽을 돌아보는 게 꿈이에요.

sentences.text: Marco quiere viajar algún día al oriente.
sentences.en: Marco wants to travel to the East someday.
sentences.ko: 마르코는 언젠가 동양으로 여행하고 싶어 해요.

sentences.text: A Elena le gusta vagar por los caminos sin un plan.
sentences.en: Elena likes to wander the paths without a plan.
sentences.ko: 엘레나는 계획 없이 길을 거니는 걸 좋아해요.

sentences.text: A Marco le gustaba vagar por las calles del casco viejo.
sentences.en: Marco liked to wander the streets of the old town.
sentences.ko: 마르코는 구시가지 골목을 거니는 걸 좋아했어요.

sentences.text: Un yate pequeño estaba anclado en el lago.
sentences.en: A small yacht was anchored on the lake.
sentences.ko: 작은 요트 한 척이 호수에 정박해 있었어요.

sentences.text: Marco alquiló un yate con sus amigos para recorrer la costa.
sentences.en: Marco rented a yacht with his friends to tour the coast.
sentences.ko: 마르코는 친구들과 요트를 빌려 해안을 돌았어요.

sentences.text: Tomás le explicó la órbita de la luna alrededor de la Tierra.
sentences.en: Tomás explained to her the moon's orbit around the Earth.
sentences.ko: 토마스는 지구 주위를 도는 달의 궤도를 설명해 줬어요.

sentences.text: El capitán habló de los satélites que están en órbita.
sentences.en: The captain talked about the satellites in orbit.
sentences.ko: 선장은 궤도를 도는 인공위성 이야기를 했어요.

sentences.text: Visitaron una cueva con un río subterráneo.
sentences.en: They visited a cave with an underground river.
sentences.ko: 그들은 지하 강이 흐르는 동굴에 가 봤어요.

sentences.text: En la ciudad tomaron un tren subterráneo hasta el museo.
sentences.en: In the city they took an underground train to the museum.
sentences.ko: 도시에서는 지하철을 타고 박물관에 갔어요.

sentences.text: Un insecto volador entró por la ventana.
sentences.en: A flying insect came in through the window.
sentences.ko: 날벌레 한 마리가 창문으로 들어왔어요.

sentences.text: En el museo había un coche volador de una película.
sentences.en: In the museum there was a flying car from a movie.
sentences.ko: 박물관에 영화에 나온 하늘을 나는 자동차가 있었어요.

sentences.text: En la fiesta del pueblo sirvieron un cóctel de frutas sin alcohol.
sentences.en: At the village party they served a non-alcoholic fruit cocktail.
sentences.ko: 마을 잔치에서 무알코올 과일 칵테일을 내놨어요.

sentences.text: Por la noche pidieron un cóctel en el bar del puerto.
sentences.en: At night they ordered a cocktail at the port bar.
sentences.ko: 밤에 항구 바에서 칵테일을 시켰어요.

sentences.text: Cuando sube la marea, la playa casi desaparece.
sentences.en: When the tide comes in, the beach almost disappears.
sentences.ko: 밀물이 들어오면 해변이 거의 사라져요.

sentences.text: Antes de salir, miraron la hora de la marea alta.
sentences.en: Before setting out, they checked the time of high tide.
sentences.ko: 떠나기 전에 만조 시간을 확인했어요.

sentences.text: En verano hay un flujo constante de turistas.
sentences.en: In summer there is a constant flow of tourists.
sentences.ko: 여름에는 관광객이 끊임없이 들어와요.

sentences.text: El flujo de coches en el puerto era enorme.
sentences.en: The flow of cars at the port was huge.
sentences.ko: 항구의 차량 흐름이 엄청났어요.
